description: This file implements a factory for creating an F1C network server, including classes for notifiers and an SCTP server, handling F1AP messages and SCTP associations within a 3GPP telecommunications context.

classes.name: f1c_to_gw_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier class for sending F1AP Tx PDUs to the SCTP gateway.

classes.name: gw_to_f1c_pdu_notifier
classes.description: Notifier class for forwarding F1AP Rx PDUs from SCTP to CU-CP.

classes.name: f1c_sctp_server
classes.description: Implements an SCTP server that interfaces with the F1-C protocol of the CU-CP, managing connections and message forwarding.

methods.name: attach_cu_cp
methods.description: Attaches a CU-CP handler and starts listening for SCTP connections.

methods.name: get_listen_port
methods.description: Returns the port number the SCTP server is listening on.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new SCTP association notifier for a new connection.
